outcomes: Interpret the model building codes: Interpret the model building codes and summarize the origins and evolution of building codes in this country. Develop skills and competencies: Develop skills and competencies for effective and competitive workforce performance.

Apply specific and measurable career and /or workforce learning objectives: Apply specific and measurable career and/ or workforce learning objective through classroom study and independent assignments.
